description:
Cargo.toml:51 declares: `reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls-manual-roots"] }`

crate-jmap-base-client/Cargo.toml:17 declares: `reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls-webpki-roots"] }`

base-client is the ONLY crate that depends on reqwest, and it does NOT inherit from workspace.dependencies. The workspace declaration is therefore dead — but worse, it is misleading: anyone reading the root Cargo.toml will believe reqwest uses manual roots, when in reality the build uses webpki-roots.

The two TLS root strategies are not equivalent:
- `rustls-tls-manual-roots`: caller must provide root certs (no compiled-in CA bundle)
- `rustls-tls-webpki-roots`: bundles the Mozilla CA list

Both are valid, but they're materially different security postures. The workspace decl should match what's actually in use.

Fix:
1. Change Cargo.toml:51 to `features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]` to match real use. (Or pick whichever is the intended posture and align both.)
2. Change crate-jmap-base-client/Cargo.toml:17 to `reqwest = { workspace = true }`.

Note: jmap-base-client is a LOCKED crate per workspace AGENTS.md — needs Mark's approval before edit. The workspace Cargo.toml is not locked.
title: P1: reqwest workspace.dependencies feature mismatch — workspace decl is dead and misleading
